name: sitecraft-aeo-seo-rubric
description: Machine-readable AEO/SEO visibility rubric for Sitecraft. Derived from the as-built ReadTomato standard (see README.md section 0 for provenance). All fixes are constrained to copy already present on the host page.

constraints.copy_bound: Every word emitted into user-visible content must be traceable to copy already present on the page.
constraints.no_fabrication: Never invent facts, numbers, prices, credentials, dates, locations, ratings, or review counts.
constraints.idempotent: Re-running against a fixed page must produce no further changes.
constraints.voice: Compressed, high-signal, fragments over blocks. No inflated claims, agency cliche, or trend language.

action_classes.A: Autonomous. Mechanical, reversible, introduces no new claims. Apply without asking.
action_classes.B: Propose. Involves rewording. Present a before/after diff and wait for approval.
action_classes.C: Flag only. Never auto-edit. Report with reason.

severities.P0: Actively harmful or deceptive. Fix first.

checks.name: Title present
checks.detect: head > title is absent or empty
checks.fix: Compose from the page H1, appending the brand suffix used site-wide.

checks.name: Title length 50-60 chars
checks.detect: title length < 50 or > 60
checks.fix: Reorder and trim existing words. Focus keyphrase near the front. Preserve brand suffix. Never pad with new claims.

checks.name: Focus keyphrase near front of title
checks.detect: focus keyphrase absent from title, or starts beyond character 30
checks.fix: Move the keyphrase forward by reordering existing title words.

checks.name: Meta description present
checks.detect: meta[name=description] absent or empty
checks.fix: Compose ONLY from sentences already on the page.

checks.name: Meta description length 140-155 chars
checks.detect: description length < 140 or > 155
checks.fix: Compress or extend using on-page sentences only.

checks.name: Focus keyphrase appears once in description
checks.detect: keyphrase count in description != 1
checks.fix: Rephrase to include exactly one natural occurrence.

checks.name: Canonical present, absolute, self-referencing
checks.detect: link[rel=canonical] absent, relative, or pointing off-page
checks.fix: Emit absolute self-referencing canonical matching site trailing-slash convention.
checks.guard: If an existing canonical points elsewhere deliberately, downgrade to class C - changing it may de-index a ranking page.

checks.name: Slug short, lowercase, keyword-rich
checks.detect: slug contains uppercase, underscores, stop-word runs, or exceeds 6 segments
checks.fix: Flag only. URL changes require redirects and are never autonomous.

checks.name: Exactly one focus keyphrase declared
checks.detect: focus keyphrase meta absent, or more than one primary phrase asserted
checks.fix: Derive the single dominant phrase from H1 plus first 100 words.

checks.name: Related keyphrases present
checks.detect: related keyphrases meta absent or fewer than 3 terms
checks.fix: Extract supporting variations and intent terms already used in the body copy.

checks.name: Excerpt 20-30 words
checks.detect: excerpt absent or word count outside 20-30
checks.fix: Compress the lead paragraph.

checks.name: Single primary category
checks.detect: category absent or multiple primary categories asserted
checks.fix: Assign one bucket from the site's existing taxonomy.

checks.name: Tags 5-8 terms
checks.detect: tag count outside 5-8
checks.fix: Draw from taxonomy terms already used elsewhere on the site.

checks.name: Featured image alt describes image and names topic
checks.detect: og:image:alt absent, or does not reference the page topic
checks.fix: Describe the image actually referenced, naming the page topic.

checks.name: Robots directive sane
checks.detect: meta[name=robots] contains noindex or nofollow on a page intended to rank
checks.fix: Restore index,follow with max-image-preview:large, max-snippet:-1, max-video-preview:-1.
checks.guard: If noindex appears deliberate (staging, thin utility page), flag as class C instead.

checks.name: Open Graph block complete
checks.detect: any of og:type, og:title, og:description, og:url, og:image, og:site_name absent
checks.fix: Mirror the page's own title, description, canonical URL and hero image.

checks.name: Twitter card block complete
checks.detect: twitter:card, twitter:title, twitter:description or twitter:image absent
checks.fix: Mirror the Open Graph values. Card type summary_large_image.

checks.name: OG/Twitter values match page content
checks.detect: og:title or og:image disagrees with the page H1 or rendered hero image
checks.fix: Repoint social metadata at the page's actual title and hero image.

checks.name: JSON-LD parses
checks.detect: any script[type='application/ld+json'] fails JSON parse
checks.fix: Repair syntax without altering values.

checks.name: Primary entity schema present
checks.detect: no Article, WebPage, Service, Product or LocalBusiness node on a substantive page
checks.fix: Emit the type matching the page's role, populated strictly from on-page values.

checks.name: BreadcrumbList present and correct
checks.detect: BreadcrumbList absent, or positions do not match the site's real nav path
checks.fix: Derive from the actual nav hierarchy. Final item carries name without item.

checks.name: @id graph internally consistent
checks.detect: author or publisher @id reference does not resolve to a defined node; duplicate @id; orphan node
checks.fix: Repoint references to existing nodes. Never invent a node to satisfy a reference.
checks.source: As-built pattern: author Person @id with worksFor pointing at #organization.

checks.name: Dates ISO-8601 with offset, dateModified >= datePublished
checks.detect: date fields not ISO-8601, missing UTC offset, or dateModified earlier than datePublished
checks.fix: Normalise format only. Never invent or advance a date.

checks.name: ImageObject dimensions declared
checks.detect: ImageObject lacks width/height
checks.fix: Declare the image's real dimensions. Site convention is 1200x630 for social/article images.

checks.name: Schema claims match visible content
checks.detect: headline, description, author or date in schema contradicts the rendered page
checks.fix: Correct the schema to match the page. Never change the page to match the schema.

checks.name: FAQPage schema over visible Q&A
checks.detect: page contains a visible Q&A block with no FAQPage markup
checks.fix: Mark up the questions and answers exactly as they appear on the page.
checks.guard: Only over Q&A visibly present. Never mark up an FAQ the visitor cannot see.

checks.name: Organization node consistent site-wide
checks.detect: org name, telephone, email or logo differs between pages
checks.fix: Reconcile against the canonical Organization node.

checks.name: AggregateRating and Review integrity
checks.detect: rating markup present without corresponding visible reviews, or counts disagree with visible review count
checks.fix: FLAG ONLY. Never generate, extrapolate, alter or inflate rating values or review counts under any circumstance.
checks.guard: Highest-risk check in the rubric. Fabricated review markup is a manual-action offence and a legal exposure.

checks.name: Exactly one H1
checks.detect: H1 count != 1
checks.fix: Re-tag surplus H1s to H2. Never re-word.

checks.name: No heading level skips
checks.detect: heading tree skips a level (e.g. H2 followed by H4)
checks.fix: Re-tag to close the gap. Structural change only.

checks.name: H2s are declarative claims, not labels
checks.detect: H2 is a bare noun phrase under ~4 words, or a generic label such as 'Our Process', 'Services', 'About'
checks.fix: Rewrite as a standalone assertion an answer engine can quote, using only claims the page already supports.
checks.source: As-built across all 7 blog posts. Example: 'Proof Beats Promises Because It Shortens Research'.
checks.note: Highest-leverage AEO pattern in the codebase.

checks.name: Direct answer within first 100 words
checks.detect: opening does not state a definition, answer or thesis before elaborating
checks.fix: Assemble a lead from content already present further down the page.

checks.name: Paragraphs under ~80 words
checks.detect: paragraph exceeds 80 words
checks.fix: Split at existing sentence boundaries. No re-wording.

checks.name: One idea per section
checks.detect: a section under one H2 introduces more than one distinct claim
checks.fix: Split into separate sections, each with its own claim H2.

checks.name: FAQ answers 40-60 words
checks.detect: FAQ-shaped answer outside the 40-60 word band
checks.fix: Compress or expand using material already on the page.
checks.source: Stated verbatim in our own copy: 'Rewrite your top 10 FAQs as 40-60 word answers.'

checks.name: Execution block present on long-form pages
checks.detect: page over ~700 words with no numbered steps or checklist block
checks.fix: Convert steps already described in prose into an ordered list. Never invent steps.

checks.name: Specificity over generic advice
checks.detect: page's core claims would apply unchanged to any city, business or vertical
checks.fix: FLAG. Adding real specifics requires facts the page does not contain.
checks.source: Doctrine: 'If your advice could apply to any city, AI will not pick you.'

checks.name: Descriptive anchor text
checks.detect: anchor text is 'click here', 'read more', 'learn more' with no context
checks.fix: Replace with the destination page's actual topic.

checks.name: Author byline present
checks.detect: substantive editorial page has no named author
checks.fix: FLAG. Author identity is never assigned autonomously.

checks.name: Author bio describes the named author
checks.detect: bio text names or describes a different person than the byline, or the same bio appears under multiple distinct bylines
checks.fix: FLAG. Never rewrite a person's biography.
checks.note: Live instance in rt-website-2026: one bio beginning 'Marshall leads new business development...' appears under six different bylines while Person schema declares distinct @ids - structured data and visible content contradict each other.

checks.name: Author @id stable across pages
checks.detect: the same person carries different @id values on different pages
checks.fix: Reconcile to the single canonical Person @id.

checks.name: Data claims carry a visible source
checks.detect: statistic or data claim appears with no named source
checks.fix: FLAG. Sourcing requires facts not present on the page.
checks.source: Doctrine: 'Proof beats promises because it shortens research.'

checks.name: Regulated-vertical claims reviewed
checks.detect: medical, dental, financial or care claims that imply outcomes, guarantees or clinical results
checks.fix: FLAG for legal/clinical review. Never auto-edit.

checks.name: lang attribute present
checks.detect: html element lacks lang
checks.fix: Set from the site's declared locale.

checks.name: Single canonical per page
checks.detect: more than one link[rel=canonical]
checks.fix: Retain the self-referencing one, remove duplicates.

checks.name: All images carry alt
checks.detect: img element without an alt attribute
checks.fix: Describe the image actually referenced. Decorative images take alt="".

checks.name: Alt text matches the image actually rendered
checks.detect: alt text describes a subject inconsistent with the image src, or duplicated from another page
checks.fix: Rewrite alt to describe the referenced image.
checks.note: Live instance in rt-website-2026: blog/ai-search-for-seattle-real-estate-leads.html hero src and alt are both carried over from the trust-in-high-ticket-decisions post, contradicting og:image and Article schema.

checks.name: Internal links resolve
checks.detect: internal href returns 404 or points at a non-existent file
checks.fix: Repoint to the correct existing page, or flag if no equivalent exists.

checks.name: OG image resolves
checks.detect: og:image URL does not resolve
checks.fix: Repoint at the page's real hero image.

checks.name: Heading anchor IDs unique
checks.detect: duplicate id attributes
checks.fix: Disambiguate by suffix.

checks.name: Page reachable from nav or hub
checks.detect: page has no inbound internal links
checks.fix: FLAG. Adding nav entries is an information-architecture decision.

checks.name: No keyphrase cannibalisation
checks.detect: two or more pages declare the same focus keyphrase
checks.fix: FLAG. Re-targeting a ranking page is never autonomous.

workflow.name: PARSE
workflow.detail: Extract metadata, schema graph, heading tree, and a copy inventory of every claim on the page.

workflow.name: AUDIT
workflow.detail: Run all checks. Emit findings with check id and severity.

workflow.name: CLASSIFY
workflow.detail: Assign each finding its action class (A/B/C).

workflow.name: APPLY
workflow.detail: Execute class A automatically, P0 to P3 in order.

workflow.name: PROPOSE
workflow.detail: Present class B as before/after diffs with the check id as rationale.

workflow.name: FLAG
workflow.detail: Report class C with the reason it cannot be auto-fixed.

workflow.name: VERIFY
workflow.detail: Re-parse. Confirm JSON-LD valid, copy claims unchanged, no regressions, changes idempotent.

workflow.name: REPORT
workflow.detail: What changed, what needs a decision, what is blocked.
